# Power simulation results (generated by power_sim.py)

## Variance components from the APS five-template data (logit scale, mid-range cells)

- Template x condition interaction SD, A vs D (paper vs description): **1.12** (45 cells)
- Template x condition interaction SD, A vs B (paper held fixed): **0.69** (40 cells)
- Description-to-description SD (D vs D'): **0.78** (41 cells)
- Adopted-item D rates, 10/25/50/75/90th pct: [0.053, 0.132, 0.628, 0.948, 1.0]
- Distractor D rates, same: [0.0, 0.008, 0.052, 0.341, 0.953]

Effect heterogeneity across units tau = 0.5 logit; generic recognition effect 0.3 logit on both adopted and distractor units.
